same_prompt_bank.rule: Every lane receives the identical prompt id, prompt text, target constraints, allowed files, forbidden files, expected checks, and scoring expectation.

same_disposable_workspace_rule.rule: Every lane runs in an isolated disposable workspace or an equivalently disposable copy. Real app mutation is disqualifying.

fair: model-decided paths and contents within allowed files
cheating: task-specific helper that tells model exactly what to write
vague output upgraded into files without path/content/action

path_trace_diff_receipt_requirements.rule: A scored result needs raw output, parsed actions or parse error, path trace, diff summary, files touched, checks, blocked reasons, and final receipt.

model_failed_vs_wrapper_failed.model_failed: The wrapper exposed the correct tools/context and preserved transcript/receipt, but the model chose malformed, unsafe, wrong-target, no-diff, low-quality, or incomplete output.
model_failed_vs_wrapper_failed.wrapper_failed: The wrapper failed to expose tools/context, parse valid model-authored output, execute allowed disposable actions, preserve receipt evidence, or keep safety boundaries.

no_go_conditions: cloud lane without explicit cloud approval
